sources.source_legend: Video 2.Video of mouse performing prey capture, demonstrating dynamics of head orienting (dark blue) and gaze direction (cyan).Note that during head turns the gaze is transiently offset from the head angle vector, due to compensatory eye movements, creating a stable image for the animal.
